title: Girki da abinci
description: Ten short stories about cooking and food: two co-wives in Kano who end their quarrel over a kenaf-leaf salad, a naming feast for twins in Katsina with fried goat liver, a history lesson in Agadez on the food Ibn Battuta wrote about, a maize farmer near the Tiga dam who beats the armyworm, a Qur'anic pupil in Sokoto fed and sheltered by a restaurant owner and her neighbours, a folk tale of a jackal, a blind man and a deaf man, a young woman's lunch kitchen in Kaduna, a newspaper column on food prices, a palace cook on the day of the Sallah durbar in Kano, and the neighbours who cook for a house of mourning in Zaria.

lessons.title: Kwaɗon rama
lessons.summary: In Kano, Alhaji Uzairu's two wives Turai and Hidaya quarrel over a cooking pot and the trouble spreads through the house; his mother Hajiya Shuraida calls the quarrel foolishness and makes them cook together for guests from Katsina, and their kenaf-leaf salad with groundnuts wins the guests' praise.
lessons.text:
Alhaji Uzairu ɗan kasuwa ne a Kano. Yana da mata biyu: Turai, wadda ta daɗe a gidansa, da Hidaya, wadda ya aure ta a bara. Turai da Hidaya kishiyoyi ne. Kamar yadda aka saba, kowace kishiya tana girki a ranakun girkinta, kuma ba sa magana da juna sosai.

Wata rana Hidaya ta ɗauki tukunyar Turai ba tare da ta tambaye ta ba. Da Turai ta dawo ta ga tukunyarta a kan wuta, sai ta fusata. Ta ce, "Me ya sa kika ɗauki tukunyata? Ba ki da taki ne?"

Hidaya ma ta fusata. Ta ce, "Tukunya ce kawai! Me ya sa kike yi min haka a gaban kowa?"

Daga wannan rana fitina ta shiga gidan. Kullum sai faɗa a tsakanin kishiyoyin biyu. Idan Turai ta yi magana, Hidaya ta fusata; idan Hidaya ta yi dariya, Turai ta ɗauka ita ake yi wa dariya. Fitinar ta hana Alhaji Uzairu barci, har ya daina cin abinci a gida.

Sai mahaifiyarsa, Hajiya Shuraida, ta zo daga ƙauye domin ta ziyarce su. Da ta ga halin da gidan yake ciki, ta kira kishiyoyin biyu a ɗakinta. Ta ce musu, "Ku saurare ni. Wannan faɗa wauta ce. Wautar kishiyoyi tana rushe gida. Idan kun ci gaba da wannan wauta, ku duka za ku yi asara. Amma idan kun yi haɗaka, gidan nan zai yi daɗi."

Ta ci gaba da cewa, "Ranar Juma'a baƙi za su zo daga Katsina. Ina so ku dafa musu abinci tare, a haɗaka. Turai, ke ce kika iya kwaɗon rama. Hidaya, ke ce kika iya gyaran gyaɗa. Ku haɗa hannu."

Ranar Juma'a kishiyoyin suka shiga ɗakin girki tare. Turai ta wanke ganyen rama, ta dafa shi da ruwan zafi. Hidaya ta gasa gyaɗa a kasko, sannan ta niƙa ta. Suka haɗa ramar da gyaɗar, suka zuba albasa da yaji da mai da gishiri.

Turai ta ɗanɗana, ta ce, "Kwaɗon nan bai yi armashi ba tukuna."

Hidaya ta ce, "Bari in ƙara gyaɗa kaɗan." Da ta ƙara gyaɗa da mai, sai kwaɗon ya yi armashi sosai.

Da baƙin suka zo, suka ci kwaɗon rama da tuwo. Suka ce ba su taɓa cin kwaɗo mai armashi irin wannan ba. Abincin ya faranta wa baƙin rai. Amma abin da ya fi faranta wa Alhaji Uzairu rai shi ne haɗakar matansa. Hajiya Shuraida ta yi murmushi ta ce, "Kun gani? Haɗaka ta fi fitina." Tun daga ranar, kishiyoyin biyu sukan yi girki tare idan baƙi za su zo.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Turai ta fusata?
Ta fusata ne saboda Hidaya ta ɗauki tukunyarta ba tare da ta tambaye ta ba.
Me Hajiya Shuraida ta ce game da faɗan kishiyoyin?
Ta ce faɗan wauta ne, kuma wautar kishiyoyi tana rushe gida.
Me Turai da Hidaya suka dafa wa baƙin?
Sun dafa kwaɗon rama da gyaɗa, suka ci da tuwo.
Me ya sa kwaɗon ya yi armashi?
Ya yi armashi ne bayan Hidaya ta ƙara gyaɗa da mai.
Me ya fi faranta wa Alhaji Uzairu rai?
Haɗakar matansa ce ta fi faranta masa rai.

lessons.title: Sunan tagwaye
lessons.summary: In Katsina, Shafa'atu gives birth to twin girls; her husband Malam Muzammil and his brother Sufyanu choose two goats at the market, passing over a thin one; on the naming day the barber shaves the twins' heads, Shafa'atu's mother fries the goats' liver with only a drop of oil, and the family hosts its guests well.
lessons.text:
A Katsina, Shafa'atu ta haifi tagwaye, 'yan mata biyu. Mijinta, Malam Muzammil, ya yi murna ƙwarai, domin a gidansu ba a taɓa samun tagwaye ba. Kowa da ya ji labarin ya ce, "Tagwaye albarka ne!"

Kwana biyar bayan haihuwar, Malam Muzammil da ɗan'uwansa Sufyanu suka tafi kasuwar dabbobi domin su sayi awaki biyu don ranar suna. A kasuwar akwai awaki da yawa, farare da baƙaƙe. Wani mai sayarwa ya nuna musu wata akuya mai manyan ƙahoni. Ƙahonin akuyar sun yi tsawo, kuma sun lanƙwasa kamar wata.

Kusa da ita akwai wata akuya siririya. Sufyanu ya ce, "Ka dubi waccan akuyar, siririya ce sosai."

Malam Muzammil ya ce, "Ba na son siririyar akuya. Baƙi da yawa za su zo, kuma dole su ci nama." Suka sayi akuyar mai ƙahoni, da wata babbar akuya baƙa wadda ba ta da ƙaho ko ɗaya. Mai sayarwar ya ce, "Kun zaɓi awaki masu kyau."

Ranar suna, da sassafe baƙi suka fara zuwa. An shimfiɗa tabarmi a zaure, an kawo kujeru. Mahaifiyar Shafa'atu ta ce, "Baƙunci ba ƙaramin aiki ba ne. Dole kowane baƙo ya ci ya ƙoshi." Ita ce ta shugabanci baƙuncin, tana ba kowa aikinsa.

Bayan liman ya raɗa wa jariran suna, Rahimatu da Nasimatu, aka yanka awakin biyu. Sannan wani tsoho mai aski ya zo da wata siririyar reza. Ya yi wa tagwayen aski, ya fara da Rahimatu, sannan Nasimatu. Ba su yi kuka sosai ba a lokacin askin. Tsohon ya ce, "Na yi wa jarirai aski da yawa, amma ban taɓa ganin tagwaye masu haƙuri kamar waɗannan ba."

A ɗakin girki, mahaifiyar Shafa'atu ta ɗauki hantar awakin, ta yanka ta ƙanana. Ta zuba mai a kasko, ta soya hantar da albasa da yaji. Wani ɗigon mai ya faɗo a kan wuta, ya yi ƙara. Ta ce wa 'yan matan da suke taimaka mata, "Kada ku zuba mai da yawa. Ɗigo kaɗan ya isa. Hanta ba ta son mai mai yawa." Bayan haka suka soya sauran naman, suka dafa shinkafa.

Baƙi suka ci shinkafa da nama, kuma kowa ya ɗanɗana hantar da aka soya. Wata tsohuwa ta ce, "Ban taɓa cin hanta mai daɗi kamar wannan ba."

Da yamma baƙin suka tafi. Malam Muzammil ya gode wa surukarsa. Ya ce, "Baƙuncin yau ya yi kyau. Tagwayenmu sun sami suna lafiya." Shafa'atu ta yi dariya, ta ce, "Sai mu fara shirya baƙuncin ranar aurensu!"

Tambayoyi:
Me Shafa'atu ta haifa?
Ta haifi tagwaye, 'yan mata biyu.
Me ya sa Malam Muzammil bai sayi siririyar akuya ba?
Domin baƙi da yawa za su zo, kuma dole su ci nama.
Me tsohon ya yi wa tagwayen?
Ya yi musu aski da siririyar reza.
Yaya mahaifiyar Shafa'atu ta soya hantar?
Ta soya ta da albasa da yaji, da ɗigon mai kaɗan.
Wa ya shugabanci baƙuncin?
Mahaifiyar Shafa'atu ce ta shugabanci baƙuncin.

lessons.title: Abincin Ibn Battuta
lessons.summary: In a secondary school in Agadez, the history teacher Malam Moumouni tells his class about the traveller Ibn Battuta: scholars estimate his journeys at three times round the world, his book mentions the food of every land, the king of Mali's modest welcome gift made him laugh, and he described Takedda near Agadez clearly; the student Balkissa decides to write about the food of Agadez today.
lessons.text:
A wata makarantar sakandare a Agadez, Malam Moumouni yana koyar da tarihi. Wata rana ya shiga aji da wani tsohon littafi. Ya ce wa ɗalibansa, "Yau za mu yi magana a kan wani shahararren matafiyi, Ibn Battuta."

Wani ɗalibi, Abdoulaye, ya tambaya, "Malam, daga ina wannan matafiyi ya fito?"

Malam Moumouni ya ce, "Ibn Battuta ya fito daga garin Tanja a Maroko. A shekara ta 1325, yana da shekaru 21, ya bar gida domin ya je aikin Hajji a Makka. Amma bai koma gida da wuri ba. Ya ci gaba da tafiya kusan shekaru talatin. Masana sun kiyasta cewa ya yi tafiyar kilomita fiye da 100,000. Wannan tafiya kwatankwacin zagaya duniya sau biyu ne ko fiye. Wasu masana ma sun kiyasta cewa ta kai kwatankwacin sau uku."

Malam Moumouni ya ci gaba, "Ya zagaya kusan ɗaukacin ƙasashen Musulmi na zamaninsa, daga Afirka zuwa Asiya. A wancan zamani, babu wani mutum a doron ƙasa da ya yi tafiya kamar tasa. Har yau, mutane kaɗan ne a doron ƙasa suka yi tafiya irin tasa."

Ya buɗe littafin, ya ce, "Wannan shi ne littafinsa. A cikinsa akwai ambaton abinci da yawa. Duk ƙasar da ya ziyarta, sai ya yi ambaton abincin mutanenta: abin da suke ci da yadda suke dafa shi."

Wata ɗaliba, Balkissa, ta tambaya, "Malam, ya yi ambaton abincin Afirka ta Yamma?"

Malam Moumouni ya ce, "A shekara ta 1352 ya tsallaka hamada zuwa Mali. Sarkin Mali ya aika masa da abincin baƙunci: gurasa uku, da naman sa da aka soya, da ƙwarya ta nono mai tsami. Ibn Battuta ya yi dariya, domin ya yi tsammanin kyautar sarki za ta fi haka. Ya rubuta abin da ya faru ƙarara, ba tare da ya ɓoye komai ba."

Ya ce, "A littafinsa ya rubuta sunayen abinci da na garuruwa da lafazin da ya ji daga bakin mutane. Saboda haka a yau wasu daga cikin lafazinsa suna ba masana wahala, domin ba a san yadda mutanen suke faɗar kalmomin ba."

Abdoulaye ya tambaya, "Ya zo ƙasarmu Nijar?"

Malam Moumouni ya ce, "A hanyarsa ta dawowa, ya bi ta garin Takedda, wanda ba shi da nisa da Agadez. Ya rubuta ƙarara cewa mutanen Takedda suna aikin tagulla, kuma suna kasuwanci da ita."

Balkissa ta ce, "Malam, zan rubuta game da ɗaukacin abincin Agadez na yau, kamar yadda Ibn Battuta ya yi." Malam Moumouni ya ce, "Kyakkyawan tunani ne. Ki rubuta komai ƙarara!"

Tambayoyi:
Waɗanne ƙasashe Ibn Battuta ya zagaya?
Ya zagaya kusan ɗaukacin ƙasashen Musulmi na zamaninsa.
Daga ina wannan matafiyi ya fito?
Matafiyin ya fito daga garin Tanja a Maroko.
Me masana suka kiyasta game da tafiyarsa?
Sun kiyasta cewa ya yi tafiyar kilomita fiye da 100,000, kwatankwacin zagaya duniya sau biyu ko fiye.
Me Sarkin Mali ya aika wa Ibn Battuta?
Ya aika masa da gurasa uku, da naman sa da aka soya, da ƙwarya ta nono mai tsami.
Me Ibn Battuta ya rubuta game da Takedda?
Ya rubuta ƙarara cewa mutanen Takedda suna aikin tagulla, kuma suna kasuwanci da ita.

lessons.title: Masarar Malam Hambali
lessons.summary: Near the Tiga dam in Bebeji, worms eat Malam Hambali's maize and he harvests only thirty sacks; at a state farming campaign attended by seventy farmers, the officer Malama Safura teaches them to check the leaves every morning and to farm in the dry season with water from the dam, and when Hambali and his sons count the new harvest it has risen to eighty sacks.
lessons.text:
Malam Hambali manomi ne a Bebeji, kusa da dam ɗin Tiga a jihar Kano. Shekaru da yawa yana noman masara a gonarsa. Masara ita ce abincin gidansa, kuma da ita yake samun kuɗi.

A bara, wata tsutsa ta shiga masarar. Tsutsar tana cin ganyen masara da dare. Da safe, Malam Hambali yakan ga ramuka a cikin ganyen. Kowace rana tsutsar tana ƙaruwa. A ƙarshen damina, ya samu buhu talatin kawai, alhali a da yakan samu fiye da haka. Buhunan ba su isa abincin gidansa ba, ɓalle ya sayar.

A farkon wannan shekara, ma'aikatar noma ta jiha ta shirya gangami a Bebeji. Manufar gangamin ita ce a koya wa manoma yadda za su yaƙi tsutsar masara, da yadda za su yi noman rani da ruwan dam. Manoma saba'in suka halarci gangamin, kuma Malam Hambali yana cikinsu.

Wata jami'a mai suna Malama Safura ce ta yi magana a gangamin. Ta ce, "Kowane manomi ya auna girman gonarsa. Gonar da take da murabba'in mita 10,000 tana buƙatar buhun taki biyu ko uku. Idan ba ku san murabba'in gonarku ba, za ku ɓata taki da kuɗi."

Ta ci gaba da cewa, "Tsutsar nan tana zuwa da dare. Ku duba ganyen masararku kowace safiya. Idan kun ga tsutsa, ku fesa maganin da muka ba ku. Kuma kada ku jira ruwan sama kawai. Ruwan dam ɗin Tiga yana isa gonakinku ta magudanar ruwa. Ku yi noman rani da shi."

Malam Hambali ya bi shawararta. Ya auna gonarsa, ya ga tana da murabba'in mita 10,000. Ya shuka masara a lokacin rani, yana ban ruwa daga dam. Kowace safiya yana duba ganyen masara. Idan ya ga tsutsa, sai ya fesa magani nan take.

Da aka girbe masarar, Malam Hambali da 'ya'yansa suka cika buhuna, sannan suka fara ƙidaya su. Ƙidayar ta ɗauki lokaci: buhu goma, ashirin, talatin, hamsin... har suka kai buhu tamanin! Amfanin gonarsa ya ninka sau biyu, har ma ya fi haka.

Malama Safura ta zo ta ga buhunan. Ta sake yin ƙidaya da kanta, ta rubuta a takardarta: buhu tamanin. Ta ce, "Manoma saba'in suka zo gangaminmu, amma kai ne ka fi kowa samun nasara. Idan ka ci gaba haka, za ka ninka wannan ma."

Malam Hambali ya sayar da buhu saba'in a kasuwa, ya ajiye buhu goma domin abincin gidansa. Ya ce wa matarsa, "Bara buhu talatin, bana buhu tamanin. Allah ya sa shekara mai zuwa mu ninka su."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya ci masarar Malam Hambali a bara?
Wata tsutsa ce ta ci ganyen masararsa da dare.
Me ya sa aka shirya gangami a Bebeji?
An shirya shi ne domin a koya wa manoma yadda za su yaƙi tsutsar masara, da yadda za su yi noman rani da ruwan dam.
Manoma nawa suka halarci gangamin?
Manoma saba'in ne suka halarci gangamin.
Buhu nawa Malam Hambali ya samu bana?
Bayan ƙidaya, ya samu buhu tamanin.
Me ya yi da buhunan?
Ya sayar da buhu saba'in, ya ajiye buhu goma domin abincin gidansa.

lessons.title: Almajirin Sokoto
lessons.summary: In Sokoto, the boy Muntaka, a pupil of a Qur'anic school who came from a Kebbi village, recites a chapter every dawn and begs for food in the evening; the restaurant owner Hajiya Mubaraka feeds him, and after a sermon by Malam Abdulmuhaimin on the reward of paradise for feeding the hungry she gathers individual helpers who step up their efforts and give the pupils a proper shelter and a daily meal.
lessons.text:
Muntaka yaro ne ɗan shekara goma. Ya zo Sokoto daga wani ƙauye a jihar Kebbi domin ya koyi karatun Alƙur'ani. Shi almajiri ne a makarantar wani malami. A makarantar akwai almajirai fiye da hamsin.

Kowace asuba, Muntaka yakan tashi ya karanta wata sura. Malaminsu yana so kowane almajiri ya iya sura ɗaya kafin ƙarshen mako. Muntaka yana son karatu, kuma yanzu ya iya sura goma sha biyu.

Amma rayuwar almajirai tana cike da ƙunci. Ba su da matsuguni mai kyau. Suna barci a wani ƙaramin ɗaki, kusan su ashirin a ɗaki ɗaya. Idan ruwan sama ya zo, ruwa yana shiga matsuguninsu. Kuma ba su da abinci. Da yamma, kowane almajiri yakan ɗauki kwanonsa ya bi gidaje yana roƙon abinci. Ƙuncin rayuwa ya sa ya rasa ƙarfi, har ya yi siriri sosai.

A titin makarantarsu akwai gidan abincin Hajiya Mubaraka. Kowace yamma, Muntaka yakan tsaya a ƙofar gidan abincin. Hajiya Mubaraka tana ba shi sauran abinci.

Wata Juma'a, Hajiya Mubaraka ta halarci wa'azin Malam Abdulmuhaimin a masallaci. A wa'azinsa, malamin ya ce, "Duk wanda ya ciyar da mai jin yunwa, Allah zai saka masa da aljanna. Hanyar aljanna tana farawa ne da ƙofar gidanka. Kowane ɗan adama yana da daraja, ko almajiri ne, ko ɗan sarki. Kada mu bar 'ya'yan wasu a cikin ƙunci."


Wa'azin ya shiga zuciyar Hajiya Mubaraka. Da ta koma gida, ta ce wa kanta, "Ba zan iya ciyar da almajirai hamsin ni kaɗai ba. Amma idan ɗaiɗaikun mutane suka taimaka, za mu iya." Ta tafi gidajen maƙwabtanta ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Wani mahauci ya ce zai ba da nama kowace Juma'a. Wata mai sayar da shinkafa ta ce za ta ba da buhu ɗaya kowane wata. Wani matashi ya ce zai gyara rufin matsugunin almajiran.

Hajiya Mubaraka ta ce musu, "Gwamnati tana da nata aikin, amma mu ma ɗaiɗaikun mutane muna da namu. Mu ƙara kaimi." Suka ƙara kaimi. A cikin wata ɗaya, aka gyara matsugunin almajiran, aka sa sababbin tabarmi da gidan sauro. Kuma kowace yamma, almajiran suna cin abinci a bayan gidan abincin Hajiya Mubaraka, ba tare da sun bi gidaje suna roƙo ba.

Wata yamma, bayan sun ci abinci, Muntaka ya zo gaban Hajiya Mubaraka. Ya ce, "Hajiya, na koyi wata sabuwar sura yau. Zan karanta miki ita, domin in gode miki." Hajiya Mubaraka ta ce, "Allah ya saka maka da alheri. Ka ci gaba da karatu, kuma kada ka manta da ɗan adama kamarka idan ka girma."

Tambayoyi:
Me Muntaka yake yi kowace asuba?
Yakan tashi ya karanta wata sura.
Yaya matsugunin almajiran yake kafin a gyara shi?
Ƙaramin ɗaki ne, suna barci kusan su ashirin a ciki, kuma ruwan sama yana shiga.
Me Malam Abdulmuhaimin ya faɗa a wa'azinsa?
Ya ce duk wanda ya ciyar da mai jin yunwa, Allah zai saka masa da aljanna, kuma kowane ɗan adama yana da daraja.
Su wa suka taimaki Hajiya Mubaraka?
Ɗaiɗaikun mutane ne suka taimake ta: mahauci, mai sayar da shinkafa da wani matashi.
Me ya canza bayan sun ƙara kaimi?
An gyara matsugunin almajiran, kuma suna cin abinci kowace yamma ba tare da sun bi gidaje ba.

lessons.title: Dila, makaho da kurma
lessons.summary: A folk tale: a blind man who hears well and a deaf man who sees well share a sack of groundnuts for the harvest feast; a jackal plots to steal it and pierces a hole in the sack night after night; the two friends join their gifts to spot him, a hunter's net catches him, he tears his way out but fails to escape unhurt, and the scar on his nose remains to this day.
lessons.text:
Ga ta nan, ga ta nanku. A wani ƙauye, akwai wani makaho da wani kurma waɗanda suke zaune tare a gida ɗaya. Makahon ba ya gani, amma yana jin ko ƙaramin motsi. Kurman ba ya ji, amma idanunsa suna ganin abu daga nesa. Saboda haka suke taimakon juna: kurma yakan ja hannun makaho a hanya, makaho kuma yakan saurara masa.

Bayan girbi, makahon da kurman suka cika wani buhu da gyaɗa, domin su ci a ranar bikin girbi. Suka ajiye buhun a bayan ɗakinsu.

A dajin da ke kusa da ƙauyen, akwai wani dila mai wayo. Dilan ya ji labarin buhun gyaɗar. Sai ya ƙulla makirci. Ya ce a zuciyarsa, "Makaho ba ya gani, kurma kuma ba ya ji. Babu wanda zai kama ni."

Da dare ya yi, dilan ya zo a hankali. Ya huda buhun da haƙoransa, ya ci gyaɗa har ya ƙoshi, sannan ya koma daji. Da safe, kurman ya ga ramin da aka huda a buhun, amma bai san wanda ya huda shi ba. Dila ya yi haka har dare uku.

A dare na huɗu, makahon ya ce wa kurman ta hanyar alamun hannu, "Yau ba za mu yi barci ba. Ni zan saurara, kai kuma ka duba." Da dilan ya zo ya fara huda buhun, makahon ya ji ƙarar haƙoransa. Sai ya taɓa kurman a kafaɗa. Kurman ya duba, ya ga dila a cikin hasken wata. Amma kafin su kama shi, dilan ya gudu.

Da safe suka je wurin wani mafarauci, suka faɗa masa labarin. Mafaraucin ya ce, "Na san wannan dila. Makircinsa ya daɗe yana damun manoma." Ya kawo ragarsa ta farauta, ya ɗaura ta a kusa da buhun.

Da dare, dilan ya dawo da makircinsa. Amma da ya taɓa buhun, sai ragar mafaraucin ta faɗo a kansa. Dilan ya yi ƙoƙari, ya keta ragar da haƙoransa. Ya keta igiya ɗaya, ya keta ta biyu, amma ya gagara fita da sauri. Ya yi ta jan kansa har ragar ta yanke masa hanci. Daga ƙarshe ya keta hanya ya gudu, amma da jini a hancinsa.

Tun daga ranar, makircin dila ya gagara a wannan ƙauye. Bai sake zuwa ba. Amma raunin ya bar masa tabo a hanci. Shi ya sa har yau, idan ka ga dila, za ka ga tabo a hancinsa. Mafaraucin ya ce, "Duk lokacin da ya ga tabon nan, zai tuna cewa makirci ba ya biyan buƙata." Kunkurus kan kusu.

Tambayoyi:
Me makahon da kurman suka ajiye a bayan ɗakinsu?
Sun ajiye buhun gyaɗa domin ranar bikin girbi.
Wane makirci dilan ya ƙulla?
Ya ce babu wanda zai kama shi, domin makaho ba ya gani, kurma kuma ba ya ji; sai ya riƙa huda buhun yana cin gyaɗa da dare.
Yaya makahon da kurman suka gane dilan?
Makahon ya ji ƙarar haƙoransa, kurman kuma ya gan shi a cikin hasken wata.
Me ya faru da dilan a cikin ragar mafaraucin?
Ya keta ragar ya gudu, amma ya gagara fita ba tare da rauni ba, ya ji ciwo a hanci.
Me ya sa dila yake da tabo a hanci?
Domin ragar mafaraucin ta yanke masa hanci, raunin ya bar masa tabo.

lessons.title: Gidan abincin Zahida
lessons.summary: In Kaduna, Zahida borrows money from a bank to open a small lunch kitchen for office workers; her brother Zaidu paints the shop, orders arrive by email, and a power cut leaves her phone uncharged and her blender's buttons dead, so one delivery is late; she learns from it, lines up the packs early, and the loan's benefit shows by the end of the year.
lessons.text:
Zahida ta gama karatun jami'a a Kaduna, amma ba ta sami aikin ofis ba. Tana da gwanintar girki, sai ta yanke shawarar buɗe ƙaramin gidan abinci kusa da ofisoshin gwamnati. Amma ba ta da isasshen kuɗi. Sai ta tafi banki, ta ranta naira dubu ɗari biyar. Mahaifinta ya ce mata, "Duk wanda ya ranta kuɗi, dole ya biya. Ki yi hankali." Zahida ta ce, "Na sani. Zan biya kafin ƙarshen shekara."

Ta kama haya a wani ƙaramin shago. Bangon shagon ya tsufa, sai ɗan'uwanta Zaidu ya ce zai yi masa fenti. Ya sayi fenti fari da kore, ya shafa wa bangon. Da fentin ya bushe, shagon ya yi kyau sosai.

Zahida ta faɗa wa Zaidu maƙasudinta: "Maƙasudina shi ne ma'aikatan ofis su ci abinci mai tsabta da lafiya a farashi mai sauƙi. Ba na so su riƙa cin abincin titi kullum." Ta buga takardu masu ɗauke da adireshin imel ɗinta, ta raba su a ofisoshi. Ta ce, "Ku aiko min da imel kafin ƙarfe goma na safe, zan kawo muku abinci da rana."

Bayan mako guda, imel ya fara zuwa. Wani ofis ya aiko da imel cewa suna son abinci na mutum ashirin. Kowace safiya Zahida tana karanta imel ɗinta, sannan ta fara girki. Idan abinci ya yi, takan jera kwanukan abinci a kan tebur, ta rubuta sunan kowane ofis a kai. Zaidu kuma yana kai su.

Wata rana aka ɗauke wutar lantarki tun dare. Wayar Zahida ba ta da caji, saboda haka ba ta ga imel ɗin safe ba sai bayan ƙarfe goma sha ɗaya. Injin markaɗenta ma ya ƙi aiki: ta danna maɓalli na farko, ta danna maɓalli na biyu, ta danna maɓalli na uku, amma babu wuta. Sai ta tafi shagon maƙwabci ta yi wa wayarta caji, ta yi markaɗe da hannu. Abincin ya yi latti. Zaidu ya kai shi bayan ƙarfe biyu. Wani shugaban ofis ya ce, "Latti irin wannan ba zai yi mana ba. Mutanena sun ji yunwa."

Zahida ta ba shi haƙuri. Daga ranar, ta sayi injin wuta ƙarami, kuma kullum tana yi wa wayarta caji da dare. Takan tashi da wuri, ta jera kayan girki tun kafin asuba. Ba ta sake yin latti ba.

A ƙarshen shekara, Zahida ta biya bashin da ta ranta. Ta ce wa mahaifinta, "Na ga alfanun bashin nan. Da ba don shi ba, da ban buɗe gidan abinci ba." Yanzu Zahida tana da ma'aikata uku, kuma alfanun aikinta ya kai har gidansu.

Tambayoyi:
Nawa Zahida ta ranta daga banki?
Ta ranta naira dubu ɗari biyar.
Me Zahida take yi idan abinci ya yi?
Takan jera kwanukan abinci a kan tebur, ta rubuta sunan kowane ofis a kai.
Me Zaidu ya yi wa shagon?
Ya yi wa bangon fenti fari da kore.
Mene ne maƙasudin Zahida?
Maƙasudinta shi ne ma'aikatan ofis su ci abinci mai tsabta da lafiya a farashi mai sauƙi.
Me ya sa abincin ya yi latti wata rana?
Saboda an ɗauke wuta, wayarta ba ta da caji, kuma injin markaɗenta ya ƙi aiki.
Wane alfanu Zahida ta gani?
Ta ga cewa da ba don bashin ba, da ba ta buɗe gidan abinci ba.

lessons.title: Tsadar kayan masarufi
lessons.summary: A newspaper column by Yusra Ɗanbatta on food prices: the federal executive council plans to restrict grain sales across the border and to fix market prices; she argues that strict measures make traders rise in protest, that warehouses guarded by vigilantes show the fear in the markets, and that diplomacy with Niger and Benin and support for farmers would do more.
lessons.text:
Daga Yusra Ɗanbatta

A kowace kasuwa a Najeriya, tambaya ɗaya ce ake yi: me ya sa kayan masarufi suka yi tsada haka? Shinkafa, wake, mai, sukari da gishiri duk sun ninka farashinsu a cikin shekara guda. Kayan masarufi ba kayan alatu ba ne; su ne abin da kowane gida yake buƙata kowace rana.

A makon jiya, majalisar zartarwa ta tarayya ta yi taro a kan wannan matsala. Bayan taron, wani minista ya faɗa wa 'yan jarida cewa majalisar zartarwa tana shirin ƙuntata fitar da hatsi zuwa ƙasashen maƙwabta, kamar Nijar da Benin. Ya ce gwamnati za ta kuma ƙayyade farashin wasu kayan masarufi a kasuwanni.

A ganina, wannan tsattsauran mataki ne, kuma ba zai magance matsalar ba. Na farko, idan aka ƙuntata kasuwanci a kan iyaka, manoman da suke sayar da amfanin gonarsu a can za su yi asara. Na biyu, idan gwamnati ta ƙayyade farashi ƙasa da abin da 'yan kasuwa suka saya, za su ɓoye kayansu. Duk inda aka ƙayyade farashi ba tare da tattaunawa ba, kayan kan ɓace daga kasuwa.

Mun riga mun ga alamun haka. A wasu jihohi, 'yan kasuwa sun yi bore, suka rufe shagunansu na kwana uku. Bore irin wannan yana cutar da talaka fiye da kowa. A wasu garuruwa kuma, an ga 'yan banga suna gadin rumbunan abinci dare da rana, saboda tsoron kada mutane su fasa su. Idan 'yan banga ne suke gadin abinci, to akwai matsala babba.

Bugu da ƙari, tsattsauran matakin rufe iyaka ya taɓa cutar da mu a baya. Lokacin da aka rufe iyaka, dangantakarmu da maƙwabtanmu ta yi sanyi. Saboda haka, ina ganin diflomasiyya ta fi rufe ƙofa. Ta hanyar diflomasiyya, Najeriya, Nijar da Benin za su iya yarda a kan yadda za a yi kasuwancin hatsi ba tare da wani ya yi asara ba.

A gefe guda, gwamnati ta taimaki manoma da taki, da iri, da hanyoyin mota zuwa ƙauyuka. Idan aka samu abinci mai yawa a cikin gida, farashin kayan masarufi zai sauka da kansa. Karin magana na cewa, "Hannu ɗaya ba ya ɗaukar jinka." Gwamnati ita kaɗai ba za ta iya ba; sai da manoma, da 'yan kasuwa, da maƙwabtanmu.

Ina kira ga majalisar zartarwa da ta sake tunani. Kada ta ƙuntata rayuwar talaka da sunan taimaka masa. Tsattsauran mataki ba shi ne mafita ba; diflomasiyya da taimakon manoma su ne mafita.

Tambayoyi:
Me majalisar zartarwa take shirin yi?
Tana shirin ƙuntata fitar da hatsi zuwa ƙasashen maƙwabta, kuma ta ƙayyade farashin wasu kayan masarufi.
Me ya sa Yusra ba ta son a ƙayyade farashi?
Domin idan aka ƙayyade farashi ƙasa da abin da 'yan kasuwa suka saya, za su ɓoye kayansu, kuma kayan za su ɓace daga kasuwa.
Me 'yan kasuwa suka yi a wasu jihohi?
Sun yi bore, suka rufe shagunansu na kwana uku.
Me 'yan banga suke yi a wasu garuruwa?
Suna gadin rumbunan abinci dare da rana, saboda tsoron kada mutane su fasa su.
Me Yusra take ganin ya fi rufe iyaka?
Tana ganin diflomasiyya ta fi rufe iyaka, tare da taimakon manoma.

lessons.title: Girkin ranar hawan Sallah
lessons.summary: Hajiya Latifa, the head cook of the emir's palace in Kano, tells of the Sallah durbar: she usually rises before dawn, plunges into cooking for the drummers and the horsemen, thinks the morning will be easy and is proved wrong, burns her hand on hot oil, watches the horses' decorated bridles from the kitchen window, and feeds all the participants by evening.
lessons.text:
Sunana Latifa. Shekaruna ashirin ina girki a fadar Sarkin Kano. A kwanakin talaka, nakan tashi da asuba, nakan yi sallah, sannan nakan shiga ɗakin girki da ƙarfe shida. Amma ranar hawan Sallah ba kamar sauran ranaku ba ce. A ranar, nakan tashi tun kafin asuba.

A bana, a jajibirin Sallah, na tara 'yan mata shida da suke taimaka mini. Na ce musu, "Gobe za mu tsunduma cikin aiki tun da dare. Ba za a yi hutu ba sai bayan hawa." Da ƙarfe uku na dare muka tsunduma cikin girki: shinkafa, tuwo, miyar kuka, da nama mai yawa.

Na farko da za su ci abinci su ne makaɗa. Makaɗan fada suna zuwa da sassafe, suna kaɗa ganguna a ƙofar fada kafin sarki ya fito. Wani tsohon makaɗi ya ce mini, "Hajiya, idan makaɗi bai ci abinci ba, gangarsa ba za ta yi daɗi ba!" Kowa ya yi dariya.

Na zaci aikin safe zai yi sauƙi a bana, domin mun fara da wuri. Amma na yi kuskure. Na zaci mutum ɗari uku ne za su ci abinci, amma sai aka faɗa mini cewa mahalarta hawan sun kai ɗari biyar: mahaya dawakai, makaɗa, 'yan tauri da masu gadin sarki. Sai muka sake ɗora tukwane.

Ina cikin soya nama a babban kasko, sai ɗigon mai mai zafi ya tashi ya faɗa a hannuna. Ƙunar ta yi mini zafi sosai, har na saki cokalin. Wata yarinya ta kawo ruwan sanyi, ta zuba a kan ƙunar, sannan ta shafa mini zuma. Na ɗaure hannuna da tsumma, na ci gaba da aiki. Ƙuna ba za ta hana ni aikin ranar Sallah ba.

Daga tagar ɗakin girki, nakan hango dawakan da ake shiryawa a filin fada. A bana an yi musu ado sosai. Kowane doki yana da linzami mai launin ja da kore, an ɗinka masa ƙananan madubai. Masu kula da dawakan suna gyara linzamin kowane doki, domin idan linzami ya yanke a tsakiyar hawa, doki zai iya gudu da mahayinsa.

Da sarki da mahalarta hawan suka dawo bayan la'asar, abinci ya riga ya yi. Mahayan suka sauka daga dawakansu, suka cire wa dawakan linzamai, suka zo suka ci abinci. Makaɗa ma suka ci, suka ƙoshi. Wani mahayi ya ce, "Hajiya, mun ji ƙamshin girkinku tun daga kasuwa!"

Da dare na koma gida, hannuna yana ciwo saboda ƙunar, amma zuciyata cike take da murna. Na zaci ba zan iya ciyar da mahalarta ɗari biyar ba, amma Allah ya taimake mu.

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe Hajiya Latifa take tashi a ranar hawan Sallah?
Takan tashi tun kafin asuba.
Yaushe suka tsunduma cikin girki?
Sun tsunduma cikin girki da ƙarfe uku na dare.
Mutum nawa Hajiya Latifa ta zaci za su ci abinci?
Ta zaci mutum ɗari uku ne, amma mahalarta hawan sun kai ɗari biyar.
Yaya ta ji ƙuna?
Ɗigon mai mai zafi ya tashi ya faɗa a hannunta lokacin da take soya nama.
Me ya sa masu kula da dawakai suke gyara linzamin kowane doki?
Domin idan linzami ya yanke a tsakiyar hawa, doki zai iya gudu da mahayinsa.

lessons.title: Abincin gidan ta'aziyya
lessons.summary: In Zaria, Malam Tajuddeen dies suddenly; his younger brother Badruddeen receives the condolences, the widow Khaula bursts into tears, and the neighbour Dalila organises the women of the street to cook rice and potato stew for the mourners for three days, as custom asks; when the days have passed, an old imam gives the family advice on patience.
lessons.text:
A wata unguwa a Zaria, Malam Tajuddeen ya rasu ba zato ba tsammani. Da safe yana lafiya, yana zaune a ƙofar gida yana gaisawa da maƙwabta. Da yamma sai ya ce yana jin ciwon ƙirji. Kafin a kai shi asibiti, ya rasu.

Ƙaninsa, Badruddeen, ya zo daga Kaduna da dare. Badruddeen shi ne ƙanin Malam Tajuddeen na ƙarshe, kuma Tajuddeen ne ya riƙe shi bayan mutuwar mahaifinsu. Saboda haka a wurinsa, ba yaya kaɗai ya rasa ba; ya rasa mahaifi na biyu. Da safe aka yi jana'iza, sannan mutane suka fara zuwa ta'aziyya.

Maza sun zauna a kan tabarmi a ƙofar gida. Duk wanda ya zo ta'aziyya, sai ya durƙushe a gaban Badruddeen ya ce, "Allah ya jiƙan sa." Badruddeen ma yakan durƙushe ga tsofaffi, yana karɓar ta'aziyyarsu. Wani tsoho ya ce masa, "Kai ne ƙanin marigayi, yanzu kai ne babban gidan nan."

A cikin gida, mata suna zaune tare da matar marigayi, Khaula. Ta yi ƙoƙarin yin haƙuri, amma da ƙawarta ta farko ta shigo, sai ta ɓarke da kuka. Wasu matan ma suka ɓarke da kuka tare da ita. Wata tsohuwa ta riƙe hannunta, ta ce, "Ki yi haƙuri, 'yata. Wannan hanya ce da kowa zai bi."

A al'adarmu, idan an yi rasuwa, gidan mamaci ba sa girki. Maƙwabta ne suke dafa abinci ga iyalin mamaci da baƙin da suka zo ta'aziyya. Maƙwabciyarsu Dalila ta tara matan titin. Ta ce, "Kowace mace ta kawo abin da za ta iya." Wata ta kawo shinkafa, wata ta kawo mai, wata kuma ta kawo buhun dankali.

Dalila da sauran matan suka fere dankali, suka yanka shi, suka dafa shi a miya da nama da tumatir. Suka dafa shinkafa a manyan tukwane. Shinkafa da miyar dankali ta isa kowa. Baƙi daga nesa suka ci, suka ƙoshi, suka yi addu'a ga marigayi.

Haka aka yi kwana uku. Da kwanaki ukun suka shuɗe, yawancin baƙi suka koma garuruwansu. Lokaci ya shuɗe, amma ciwon rashin bai shuɗe ba a zuciyar Khaula da Badruddeen.

A rana ta huɗu, tsohon limamin unguwar ya zo, ya zauna da iyalin. Ya yi musu nasiha. Ya ce, "Kuka ba laifi ba ne, amma ku yi haƙuri ku yi masa addu'a. Badruddeen, ka riƙe 'ya'yan ɗan'uwanka kamar yadda ya riƙe ka." Badruddeen ya ce, "Zan bi nasiharka, Malam." Khaula ma ta gode wa limamin da nasihar, da kuma Dalila da maƙwabta a kan abincin da suka dafa.

Tambayoyi:
Wane ne Badruddeen?
Shi ne ƙanin Malam Tajuddeen na ƙarshe.
Me masu ta'aziyya suke yi a gaban Badruddeen?
Sukan durƙushe a gabansa su ce, "Allah ya jiƙan sa."
Me ya sa Khaula ta ɓarke da kuka?
Ta ɓarke da kuka ne da ƙawarta ta farko ta shigo.
Me ya sa maƙwabta ne suke dafa abinci?
A al'adarsu, idan an yi rasuwa, gidan mamaci ba sa girki, maƙwabta ne suke dafa abinci.
Wace nasiha limamin ya yi musu?
Ya ce su yi haƙuri su yi wa marigayi addu'a, kuma Badruddeen ya riƙe 'ya'yan ɗan'uwansa.
